name: Multi-Metric Benchmark of Metaheuristic Multilevel Thresholding for Brain MRI and CT
description: Code, test images, raw per-run results, and analysis scripts of the study “A Multi-Metric Benchmark of Metaheuristic Multilevel Thresholding for Brain MRI and CT: Toward Annotation-Free Lesion Delineation in Diagnostic Workflows” (Diagnostics, MDPI, submitted). Ten population-based optimizers (RSA, HBA, OPA, BES, GWO, CSA, HHO, TSO, PSO, and DE) maximize the Kapur, Otsu, and Tsallis criteria on 20 brain MRI and CT slices at K = 7, 8, and 9 thresholds. All methods run on one framework with a budget of 3030 objective evaluations and a deterministic seed per run, 51 times per configuration, for 91,800 runs. Each run is scored on the objective value, PSNR, and SSIM, and against the exact optimum of the Kapur and Otsu criteria, which is computed by dynamic programming. The record has two files. The zip contains the framework, the 91,800 runs, the exact optima, the statistical analysis (Friedman, Iman–Davenport, Shaffer, and Wilcoxon), the figures, and a script that reproduces every table and figure. The separate file raw_runs_curves.jsonl.xz contains the convergence curve of every run. The deposit includes 17 of the 20 test slices: 11 tumor MRI slices from the Brain Tumor MRI Dataset (CC BY 4.0) and 6 non-tumor slices from the IXI dataset (CC BY-SA 3.0). The 3 stroke CT slices are not included because their source states no license; they are identified by file name and SHA-256 checksum so they can be downloaded from the original source.
